final_message:
I wrote the covenant extraction memo (about 11,000 words); the main finding is that Vantage appears to be breaching its Senior Secured Net Leverage covenant now. The certificate reports 3.15x, but its own figures give 3.68x, or 3.74x once the secured leases are counted, against a 3.25x cap. Curing it needs roughly $9–10M of equity by about November 29, 2024. Change of Control is triggered, but only Required Lenders (more than 50%) need to consent, not all four lenders. Distributions for the holdco debt are blocked, and the memo recommends refinancing the facility at closing.
